blocks.html: OneAccord wants you leaning on AI to work faster in Zoho, not fighting the system by hand. This lesson covers two different AI tools you have access to: Zia, Zoho's own built-in assistant, and Claude, which is connected directly to our Zoho environment.

1. Zia: Zoho's Built-In AI

Zia is Zoho's artificial intelligence, built into the CRM itself. She watches patterns, answers questions, and helps you maintain data integrity — all without leaving Zoho.

  • Ask About Your Data: Type or say a natural-language question like "Show my Buyer's Journeys closing this month" or "What's my revenue this quarter?" and Zia will pull the answer.
  • Data Enrichment: If you have a company's website, Zia can often "crawl" the web to find their address, social media profiles, and description for you.
  • Best Time to Contact: Zia analyzes when a contact usually opens your emails or answers their phone and suggests the "Best Time to Contact" right on their profile.
  • Reminders: Zia will alert you if she thinks you've forgotten to follow up on a promising record.
  • Tasks & Meetings by Voice or Text: You can ask Zia to set a reminder, create a task, or schedule a meeting or call, using either voice or typed text.

2. Claude: Your AI Assistant, Connected to Zoho

If you have Claude access at OneAccord, it's connected directly to our Zoho environment — meaning you can talk to it about your actual records, not just ask generic questions.

Things you can ask Claude to do:

  • Search your records: "Find all my open Leads from this month" or "Pull up the Buyer's Journey for [Company]."
  • Ask questions about your pipeline: "Which of my Contacts haven't I talked to in 30 days?" or "Summarize where things stand with [Contact]."
  • Update records: Add or update notes, log a call or meeting, or fill in details on a Lead, Contact, Company, or Buyer's Journey record.

What Claude can't do: Move a record to the next Blueprint stage. Stage transitions are gated by Zoho's Blueprint buttons, which require a manual click in the CRM itself — Claude can't push that button for you. The best practice: ask Claude for a direct link to the record, then open it in Zoho and click the transition yourself.

blocks.label: Find it now
blocks.instructions: Ask Claude a question about one of your own Leads or Buyer's Journey records — for example, ask it to summarize where things stand, or ask for a direct link to a specific record.

blocks.prompt: Which of these is something Zia can help you do?
options: Move a Buyer's Journey record to the next Blueprint stage automatically
Suggest the best time to contact a Lead based on their email and call patterns
Sign a contract on your behalf
blocks.feedbackCorrect: Correct — Zia's Best Time to Contact feature analyzes patterns and suggests when to reach out.
blocks.feedbackIncorrect: Zia can suggest the best time to contact a Lead based on their email and call patterns — she doesn't move stages or sign anything on your behalf.

blocks.prompt: Why can't you just ask Claude to move a record to the next stage of the Buyer's Journey?
options: Claude doesn't have any access to our Zoho environment
Stage transitions are gated by Zoho's Blueprint buttons, which require a manual click in the CRM
Only Managing Principals are allowed to move stages
blocks.feedbackCorrect: Correct — Blueprint transitions require a manual click in Zoho itself. Ask Claude for a direct link to the record, then click the button yourself.
blocks.feedbackIncorrect: It's because stage transitions are gated by Zoho's Blueprint buttons, which require a manual click in the CRM. Ask Claude for a link to the record instead, and make the move yourself.
